title: Section of a morphism of schemes
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes. A *section* of $f$ is a morphism of schemes $\sigma:S\to X$ with $f\circ\sigma=\mathrm{id}_S$. Equivalently, $\sigma$ is a morphism of schemes over $S$ from $S$ (with structure morphism $\mathrm{id}_S$) to $X$ (with structure morphism $f$).

source.place: node def-pc-base-change, order 451: 'If $f$ has a section $\sigma:S\to X$'

external.place: the term is used without a labelled definition; the notion is the categorical one, a right inverse of $f$ in the category of schemes (Tag 01JX, Schemes, Definition 26.18.1 (3), for the equivalent description as a morphism over $S$)
